name: Price Report Cancellation V 05
definition: SCOPE|A report provider, for example, a transfer agent, fund accountant or market data provider, sends the PriceReportCancellation message to the report recipient, for example, a fund management company, transfer agent, market data provider, regulator or any other interested party to cancel previously sent prices.||USAGE|The PriceReportCancellation message is used to either: |- cancel an entire PriceReport that was previously sent (by quoting the business reference of the original price report in the PriceReportIdentification element), or,|- cancel one or more individual prices from a previously sent price report (by using the PriceDetailsToBeCancelled sequence).|Technically, it is possible to cancel all the prices individually by using the PriceDetailsToBeCancelled sequence, but this is not recommended.|The cancellation should not contain the cancellation of prices for more than one NAV date.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Reference that uniquely identifies a message from a business application standpoint.

PoolReference.name: Pool Reference
PoolReference.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

PreviousReference.name: Previous Reference
PreviousReference.definition: Reference to a linked message that was previously sent.

PriceReportIdentification.name: Price Report Identification
PriceReportIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the price report, as assigned by the reporting party.

CancellationIdentification.name: Cancellation Identification
CancellationIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the cancellation of the previous price report, as assigned by the reporting party.

ExpectedPriceCorrectionDate.name: Expected Price Correction Date
ExpectedPriceCorrectionDate.definition: Date or date and time the price will be corrected.

CompletePriceCancellation.name: Complete Price Cancellation
CompletePriceCancellation.definition: Indicates whether or not all the prices of the referenced price report are cancelled.

CancelledPriceValuationDetails.name: Cancelled Price Valuation Details
CancelledPriceValuationDetails.definition: Details of prices to be cancelled.

Extension.name: Extension
Extension.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

CompletePriceCancellation1Rule.definition: If CompletePriceCancellation is "false" or "0" (No), then one or more instances of CancelledPriceValuationDetails must be present.

CompletePriceCancellation2Rule.definition: If CompletePriceCancellation is "true" or "1" (Yes), then CancelledPriceValuationDetails must not be present.
